claim_under_test: Earlier chorus entry is generally associated with stronger commercial/chart outcomes.

evidence.result: first chorus relative position vs weeks on chart: rho=-0.0212, q=.6388; vs peak strength: rho=-0.0236, q=.6381
first chorus seconds vs Year-End strength: rho=.0948, q=.1576; controlled partial rho=.0748, p=.1755

evidence.cohort: M300 exact CoSoD licensed intersection, N=52
evidence.result: first chorus seconds vs M300 rank strength: rho=.1395, q=.6481; vs current log Spotify playcount: rho=.0401, q=.7934

interpretation: Across three bounded analyses, no evidence passed the predeclared association gates. This is evidence against adopting a universal early-chorus success rule, not proof that chorus timing has no effect in every genre/style, audience, platform or experimental condition.
generative_consequence: No MIDI timing constraint may be justified from an early-chorus-equals-success claim on the current evidence.
future_test_status: May be reopened only for a clearly scoped population with new evidence and predeclared analysis.
